from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
old=Path('reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_exposure_joint_cases_v1')
base=Path('reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_full_original_panel_source_v1')
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proposal=readj(old/'next_experiment.json')
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E105' and proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
assert not base.exists(),'已登记来源实验不得重新选择'
for parent in proposal['parents']:
 assert sha(parent['path'])==parent['sha256'],'上轮原来源或身份已改变'
for row in proposal['existing_original_reports_selected_before_new_portfolio_values']:
 assert sha(row['fact_receipt'])==row['fact_receipt_sha256']
 assert sha(row['pdf_path'])==row['pdf_sha256_from_original_receipt']
assert readj(old/'result.json')['fixed_coarse_fund_bridge_qualified']==3
base.mkdir(parents=True)
p={**proposal,'study_id':'510300_FUND_QUARTERLY_AGGREGATE_FULL_ORIGINAL_PANEL_SOURCE_V1',
 'status':'REGISTERED_FIXED_29_EXISTING_REPORTS_BEFORE_REMAINING_26_AGGREGATE_EXTRACTIONS',
 'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'proposal_sha256':sha(old/'next_experiment.json'),
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E104_NEW_THREE_COARSE_PUBLIC_FUND_POPULATION_EXPOSURES_AND_SAME_CLOCK_STATES_E103_ROUTE_ENDED',
 'previous_goal_turn_actual_progress':'3原报告/8完整页/76门类与实际SSE原目录、自身观察年龄及原资金订单回款成本库存状态已完成；不是仅提案。',
 'previous_goal_turn_new_financial_candidates':0,'root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0,
 'same_original_member_and_score_metadata_selection_sha256':sha(proposal['fixed_metadata_selection_path']),
 'all_original_1212_mature_pool_members_preserved':True,'reuse_E104_original_3_rows_path':str(old/'三原季度全门类数量分母及自身公开证据.json').replace('\\','/'),
 'reuse_E104_raw_3_records_path':str(old/'三完整原组合跨页及官方目录日期证据.json').replace('\\','/'),
 'source_completion_not_goal_completion':True,'new_prospective_forecasts':False,'orders_authorized':False}
(base/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'experiment':'E105','fixed_local_reports':29,'new_original_PDF_reads_max':26,'reuse_originals':3,
 'network_requests':0,'financial_candidates':0,'fits':0,'source_code_edits':0},ensure_ascii=False))
